# Env Prep
```{r}
library(Rmagic)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(reticulate)
library(viridis)
library(Seurat)
use_condaenv('/project/imoskowitz/itarampoulous/B-CondaEnvs/Pymagic')
```

```{r}
v5.2 <- readRDS("/project/imoskowitz/wiktor/2-projects/2-Mesp1creGli3T_scRNAseq_Guzetta/v5_seurat_filtering_subsetting_v5.1_v5.2/rds_files/v5.2_harmonized_cardiac_lineage_shf_jcf.rds")
```

# Prep counts
```{r}
raw_counts <- as.matrix(v5.2[["RNA"]]$counts)
raw_counts <- t(raw_counts)

# Remove genes that are expressed in less than 10 cells 
keep_cols <- colSums(raw_counts > 0) > 10
raw_counts <- raw_counts[,keep_cols]

# Library size normalization
normalized_counts <- library.size.normalize(raw_counts) 
# Square root norm to avoid log10 zeros instabilities
normalized_counts <- sqrt(normalized_counts)

# Convert to data frame
normalized_counts_before_magic <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(normalized_counts))
# saveRDS(normalized_counts_before_magic, "v5.2_lib_norm_sqrt_counts_BEFORE_MAGIC.rds")
```

```{r}
v5.2_afterMAGIC_t3 <- magic(normalized_counts_before_magic, genes = "all_genes", t=3)
v5.2_afterMAGIC_t4 <- magic(normalized_counts_before_magic, genes = "all_genes", t=4, init= v5.2_afterMAGIC_t3)
v5.2_afterMAGIC_auto <- magic(normalized_counts_before_magic, genes = "all_genes", t='auto', init= v5.2_afterMAGIC_t3) # selected t =11
```


```{r}
ggplot(normalized_counts_before_magic) +
  geom_point(aes(x=Gli1, y=Myl7, color=Isl1)) 

ggplot(v5.2_afterMAGIC_t3) +
  geom_point(aes(x=Gli1, y=Myl7, color=Isl1)) 

ggplot(v5.2_afterMAGIC_t4) +
  geom_point(aes(x=Gli1, y=Myl7, color=Isl1)) 

ggplot(v5.2_afterMAGIC_auto) +
  geom_point(aes(x=Gli1, y=Myl7, color=Isl1)) 
```


```{r}
saveRDS(v5.2_afterMAGIC_t3, "v5.2_afterMAGIC_t3.rds")
saveRDS(v5.2_afterMAGIC_t4, "v5.2_afterMAGIC_t4.rds")
saveRDS(v5.2_afterMAGIC_auto, "v5.2_afterMAGIC_t11_auto.rds")
```
